text:
sophia: Quick note from tsunami-v1 q4 bring-up: when input mixes Arabic and Chinese we sometimes see duplicated parentheses around the Arabic phrase in responses. Appears quant-specific.

sophia: Repro (canary tsunami-v1.q4):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/canary/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"tsunami-v1.q4","input":"\u4eca\u5929\u7684\u65b0\u95fb (\u0627\u0644\u062a\u0642\u0631\u064a\u0631) \u5b8c\u6210\u4e86\u3002"}'
```

sophia: expected:  今天的新闻 (التقرير) 完成了。
sophia: observed:  今天的新闻 ((التقرير)) 完成了。 <-- extra parens around Arabic phrase

mei: Can you paste tokenizer output + bidi classes so we see how ON tokens are handled?

sophia: Token dump from canary q4 run:
```
tokens: ["\u4eca\u5929","\u7684","\u65b0\u95fb"," ","(","\u0627\u0644\u062a\u0642\u0631\u064a\u0631"," ",")"," ","\u5b8c\u6210","\u4e86","\u3002"]\nbidi: [LTR,LTR,LTR,WS,ON,RTL,WS,ON,WS,LTR,LTR,ON]
```

sophia: Looks like paren is ON class. q4 runtime seems to duplicate when reconstructing from KV indices. int8/fp16 are clean.

luca: We recently changed short-token packing offsets in q4 kernel to tighten memory. Small alignment shift can affect mapping of ON tokens next to RTL runs.

tariq: Reproduced locally with synthetic mixes. Starting bisect across q4 commits.

luca: If it's index mapping, adding asserts in token->kvcache mapping for ON around RTL should catch it. I'll add tests.

l10n-bot: Created locale set "ar-zh-paren" (800 examples). Baseline eval: tsunami-v1.fp16 BLEU 6.8; tsunami-v1.q4 BLEU 3.9; tsunami-v1.int8 BLEU 6.7. Fail list saved to /datasets/locale-onboard/ar-zh-paren/fails-2735567890.json

ci-bot: Kicked off bisect job job-5543. ETA ~30m.

mei: Short-term mitigation: route requests that contain CJK + strong RTL to int8/FP16 on canary and dedicated until fix. Low-risk and avoids user regressions.

tariq: Bisect narrowed culprit to commit c1b2ea that introduced small-token pack tweak. Building alignment-off variant now.

luca: Pushed unit test and an alignment-off q4 build. Will run canary.

ci-bot: Bisect complete. Confirmed culprit commit. q4 build with packing disabled for ON tokens near RTL is green in A/B.

sophia: Nice. Please push hotfix toggle and add monitoring hook. Save failing examples to /tmp/tsunami-q4-ar-zh-fails.json.

luca: Hotfix pushed: q4-disable-on-pack. PR #4201 opened with unit tests for: RTL-surrounded ON tokens, mixed neutral punctuation, and ZWJ/ZWNJ edge cases. Assign @mei and @tariq.

ci-bot: Canary deploy tsunami-v1.q4-hotfix: health checks pass. Locale regression ar-zh-paren: BLEU q4-hotfix 6.6 (fp16 6.8). Spot-check: no duplicate parens.

mei: Thanks. Add a CI guard that runs ar-zh-paren on every q4 kernel change and a regression alert if BLEU delta >1.5. Also create a small live monitor on canary for 48h.

sophia: Thx everyone. Leaving watch on dashboard for 24h and will escalate if drift. :pray:
